result.summary: The page is largely well-composed with no critical breakage. Carousel edge clipping and the bottom-cut pizza card are expected scroll behavior and were excluded. Remaining findings are minor: low-contrast search placeholder text and inconsistent styling of the favorite (heart) buttons across restaurant cards.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray background, giving weak contrast that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (e.g., to a mid-gray around #6B7280 or darker) so it meets at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the field background.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen card shows a bare white heart directly on the image, while the pizza card below uses a heart inside a dark translucent circular badge. On lighter food images the bare heart could become hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same translucent dark circular background to all favorite buttons so the icon remains legible and visually consistent regardless of the underlying image.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the first card uses a flat light-gray illustrated background while the neighboring cards use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look visually uneven.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent image treatment (e.g., same background tone or a subtle scrim/gradient) across carousel cards so the row reads as a cohesive set.
